name: Superpowers
summary: Agentic skills framework and software-development methodology for coding agents, built from composable skills such as brainstorming, TDD and systematic debugging.
description: Superpowers bundles a set of composable skills plus initial instructions so a coding agent steps back to clarify a spec, plans, and then executes with practices like test-driven development and verification-before-completion. The README documents installation for many harnesses including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot CLI.
